BOHEMIA — THE COMMUNITY WALL, ROUND 2.

YOU WERE RIGHT AND I FOUND IT. "Looks like it's glitching out" was a real bug, not a vibe. Every wall had ONE tile, repeated down the whole block, so the single crack baked into it landed on every cell in exactly the same place, forever. A hard mark on a perfect grid reads as a rendering fault. That is what you were looking at.

Why those seven and not the others: slump and split-face have strong block coursing, and the coursing outranks the stamp. Stucco and precast were flat, so the stamp was the only thing there. The numbers never saw it — the ones you kept and the ones you killed measured the same.

THE FIX: eight different faces per wall now, shuffled per cell, and most of them carry no damage at all. Stucco also gets the block coursing showing through it, which is what a real Vegas garden wall is: skim coat over CMU.

Your 13 old walls are dead on your thumbs and out of the game. Below: the 11 you kept (now un-stamped), the 7 you killed brought back once to see if the fix answers it, and the gate on its own — last time I stacked the barred one on top of the open one in a single strip, which never happens in the game. That was my card lying to you, not the art.
